voices.description: Every part's published versions (each names its partKey), each part's default first, as the catalogue's versions.

grant.description: Why the caller may have it: a song the app bundles (free, signed out too), any signed-in account (account: every library song since 2026-11-07), Hillel or the editor reviewing (admin, never counted toward the daily cap); for a person's template, their own, an unlisted template's link, a choir group's song, or a project they sing in made from it. public: a template listed in the library (N3). idea: a tune shared as an idea, while it's listed. open: signed out, a library song the public site shows (live, reviewed, public domain), its current version only (since 2026-11-08).

freeUntil.description: Always null: the song of the month ended on 2026-11-07. Kept for older apps.

library.description: Only for a public template (N3): its creator, for the credits in exports, and its uses and rating.

boards.description: Whether its parts have leaderboards (boards.show answers): our songs, and a person's own song while it's public (Boards' own rule). The app shows a part's Leaderboard link only when true.
